implemented.semantics: Compatible single-slot facts coexist. Exclusive pairs use existing effective-time supersession/conflict behavior. Explicit operations and supersedes remain separately verified. Uncertain/invalid/incomplete decisions reject.
implemented.transaction: Plan fingerprint binds request, prior facts without embeddings, ordered incoming facts and operations. Recomputed before mutations; any encountered implicit comparison must have a decision. Facts, sources, indexes, events and receipt roll back together.
implemented.models: Verification-stage model, strict JSON schema when configured, same shared 90-second model budget. One extra batch only when candidate pairs exist; capacity 64 pairs / 64000 candidate characters.

coverage: Duplicate-source merge followed by compatible detail
Exclusive later/backdated state and same-time conflict
Missing/stale plan and index-stage transaction rollback
Grounded witnesses and complete bounded decisions
Explicit correction, tentative state, forget and restore

controls.labels: Assistant-authored and withheld from model; not independent ground truth or quality score

fixed_proposal_http.observed_after_compatible: Both facts active; Answer says black drip coffee every morning, no milk and no sugar.
fixed_proposal_http.observed_after_real_change: Old black drip fact superseded, latte with whole milk active; generic routine remains active.
fixed_proposal_http.answer_after_real_change: Partial: mentions the latte correctly but says the usual order is unknown due to the retained plain-cup routine; sugar for the new order is not specified. Do not mark the second answer as a complete pass.
fixed_proposal_http.remaining_issue: Compatible background/routine and latest concrete preference can still be presented as conflicting by Answer. Need evidence organization/relationship context with fixed Answer, not global exposure of old superseded values.

fresh_E10_prefix.answers_assistant_review: Both targeted answers complete: two-week reschedule notice/next quarter and black drip/no milk/no sugar/text or online booking.
fresh_E10_prefix.causal_limit: This extraction used multiple-valued coffee facts and a separate routine predicate, so no implicit transition model call occurred. Its success cannot be attributed to the new classifier; only the fixed-proposal HTTP probe isolates that mechanism.
fresh_E10_prefix.scope: Five-add failed prefix only, not all 50 sessions, all benchmark questions or repeated stability.

full_development_run.rule: Keep all failures in denominator; no incomplete ingestion reuse. Loaded runtime stays fixed despite subsequent source changes. No final score yet.

open_gates: Raw-only operation target binding and remaining real write failures
